Name: (CP) Herring Axe
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[url=https://youtu.be/TQQ32lEqCS0?si=YkcadRL4tATNs2BN&t=51]Cut down the mightiest trees in the forest...WIIITH...A HERRING!

[/url]--

What it says on the tin: a graphic edit to make your axe into a herring, complete with metal finishes for copper, iron, gold, and iridium. Added lil sparkly scales to better differentiate it from the herring fish in inventory while it's the base axe.
Also has an option to toggle it on and off at will, best utilized via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/url].



To install--
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher. Generic Mod Config Menu optional, to toggle on and off.
